::: {#sol-heads-cost}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
head_counts = {str(h): n_params(nn.MultiheadAttention(64, h)) for h in [1, 16]}
print(head_counts)
```

`r format(py$head_counts[["1"]], big.mark = ",")` with 1 head,
and `r format(py$head_counts[["16"]], big.mark = ",")` with 16.
The count is the same as with 4 heads in @exm-multi-head-attention,
because each of $h$ heads projects to $d / h$ columns,
so the projections always have $d$ columns in all.

:::
